name: ipropy-crm
description: iPropy — AI-native, metadata-driven CRM for real estate

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ipropy/shared && npm run build -w @ipropy/server && npm run build -w @ipropy/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ipropy/server" "npm run dev -w @ipropy/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ipropy/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ipropy/server && npm run typecheck -w @ipropy/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
